description.en:
The comparison operator for the threshold. Valid values:

- `>=`

- `=`

- `<=`

- `>`

- `<`

- `!=`.

description.zh: 报警联系人组。多个联系人组之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The alert contact group. Separate multiple alert contact groups with commas (,).

description.zh: 报警规则生效的时间范围。取值范围：00:00-23:59。
description.en: The time range during which the alert rule is effective. Valid values: 00:00-23:59.
The subject of the alert email.
The number of retries for the alert.

description.zh:
自定义监控数据所属应用分组ID。

> 0表示上报的自定义监控数据不属于任何一个应用分组。
description.en:
The ID of the application group to which the custom monitoring data belongs.

> A value of 0 indicates that the reported custom monitoring data does not belong to any application group.

description.zh:
报警级别。取值：
- CRITICAL：严重。
- WARN：警告。
- INFO：信息。
description.en:
The severity level of the alert. Valid values:
- CRITICAL: critical.
- WARN: warning.
- INFO: information.

description.zh:
监控项名称。

> 获取方法请参见[DescribeCustomMetricList](~~115005~~)。
description.en:
The name of the metric.

> For information about how to obtain the metric name, see [DescribeCustomMetricList](~~115005~~).

description.zh: 自定义监控数据的聚合周期。单位：秒。取值为60或60的整数倍。默认为自定义监控数据的原始上报周期。
description.en: The aggregation period of the custom monitoring data. Unit: seconds. The value must be 60 or a multiple of 60. Default value: the original reporting period of the custom monitoring data.

description.zh: 报警规则作用的自定义监控数据。由自定义监控数据所属应用分组ID和监控项所属维度组成。
description.en: The custom monitoring data to which the alert rule applies. The value consists of the application group ID to which the custom monitoring data belongs and the dimensions of the metric.

description.zh:
报警规则ID。

> 如果报警规则ID已存在，则表示修改报警规则；如果报警规则ID不存在，则表示创建报警规则。
description.en:
The ID of the alert rule.

> If the alert rule ID already exists, the alert rule is modified. If the alert rule ID does not exist, an alert rule is created.
The name of the alert rule.

description.zh:
通道沉默周期。单位：秒，默认值：86400（1天）。

> 当监控数据持续超过报警规则阈值时，每个沉默周期内只发送一次报警通知。
description.en:
The mute for period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (1 day).

> If monitoring data continuously exceeds the alert rule threshold, only one alert notification is sent within each mute for period.
The statistical method for the alert.

description.zh: 报警发生回调时指定的URL地址，向URL发送POST请求。
description.en: The webhook URL that is called when an alert is triggered. A POST request is sent to this URL.

title.zh: 创建自定义监控报警规则
title.en: Create a custom monitoring alert rule

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口前，请先调用PutCustomMetric接口上报自定义监控数据，详情请参见 [PutCustomMetric](~~115004~~)。
descriptions.en: Before calling this operation, call the PutCustomMetric operation to report custom monitoring data. For more information, see [PutCustomMetric](~~115004~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms put-custom-metric-rule --group-id 73780000 --rule-id MyRuleId1 --rule-name CpuUsage --metric-name cpu_total --resources groupId_:73780000,_dimension_:_instanceId=i-hp3543t5e4sudb3s0000 --contact-groups ECS_Group --webhook https://www.aliyun.com --effective-interval 00:00-23:59 --silence-time 86400 --period 300 --email-subject ECS_instance --threshold 90 --level CRITICAL --evaluation-count 3 --statistics Average --comparison-operator = --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutCustomMetricRule --region cn-hangzhou --ContactGroups ECS_Group --SilenceTime 86400 --ComparisonOperator '=' --RuleId MyRuleId1 --Period 300 --EvaluationCount 3 --EffectiveInterval '00:00-23:59' --Statistics Average --GroupId 73780000 --MetricName cpu_total --EmailSubject ECS_instance --Webhook 'https://www.aliyun.com' --Level CRITICAL --Resources 'groupId_:73780000,_dimension_:_instanceId=i-hp3543t5e4sudb3s0000' --RuleName CpuUsage --Threshold 90
